Question: a boy want to marry a gilr (muslim). One day i did Istekhara(with niyat that to seek what is allah's marzi n if i will be happy with him or not), on next moring i did not see any thing but felt that he is right choice. Next day when i did istekhara again, i could see one of my friend telling about that boy in dream. Next day also when i did istekhara, i again felt presence of that boy. That boy also did istekhara, he did not see me but saw many things of mine in dream (eg - a lady wearing same dress as i have, but did not see her face). i am really confused. shall i take for grant that its allah's wish?? please help me out as soon as possible Regards! Answer ID: 9518 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2510/470=TH/1429) If there is no hindrance as per the Shariah, you can marry with the mediation of your guardians. The istekharah indicates to the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
